scene_1.visual_plan: The scene opens with a medium shot of the model looking directly at the camera in a bright and inviting car interior, creating an inviting atmosphere. She begins her dialogue, then a smooth cut transitions to a close-up of the Ottocast Play2Video Ultra held in her right hand, showcasing its sleek design. The camera then returns to a medium shot of the model as she expresses her thoughts, maintaining a soft focus on the background to highlight her satisfaction. As she continues speaking about her experience, there’s a gentle cut to a POV shot of the product positioned close to her face while she smiles, allowing viewers to see her excitement and connection to the product.
scene_1.dialogue: 正直言うと、車の純正CarPlayでは物足りなくて、もっと楽しみたいと思っていたんです。でも何を試してもうまくいかなくて諦めかけていたときに、偶然見つけたのがOttocast Play2Video Ultraでした。
